notes: I rewrote the model to collapse runs of identical letters (only when the word is uniform case, per `Hello`→`Heloh` vs `hello`→`helo`/`HELLO`→`HELOh`), and to append `h` except when the result is all-lowercase and ends in `o` or `y` (explaining `helo`, `hapy` having no `h` while `bokh`, `seh`, `cofeh` do). Multi-word cases like `hello world`→`helo wrd` remain uncertain and are marked with `?`.
